answer_1.quote: We evaluate the Synthesizer on the following tasks: • Mathematical reasoning benchmarks, including GSM8k  and MATH500  ... • Table answering (TableQA) benchmarks, including WikiTQ  and FeTaQA ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers to math and table-based questions with chain-of-thought reasoning and final answers in structured format.

answer_2.quote: on the GSM8k, MATH500, and WikiTQ datasets, we use EM to calculate accuracy... we select Rouge-L as the evaluation metric to better assess the quality of textual answers.

answer_3.quote: we use CritiqueLLM , which is an LLM focused on evaluating the reasoning process and the consistency of answers with the benchmark set through scoring.
methods: scoring synthesized answers for reasoning and consistency
